notes:
Account snapshot / CRM notes:
- Product: Continuum builds an AI-first IDE (FluxIDE) used by enterprise customers for code search, inline completions, and automated PR summarization.
- Primary need: low-latency streaming for editor completions (<120ms median ideally), and a high-throughput backend for nightly codebase embedding refreshes (target ~10M vectors/day).
- Current infra: hybrid (cloud prod, on-prem for sensitive customers). Want unified API whether hosted or dedicated.
- POC scope: 1) embedding refresh job that runs incremental diffs + upload (goal: 8–12M vectors/day), 2) streaming completions benchmark (editor latency + token-level streaming), 3) model pinning + rollback test for deterministic suggestions.
- Tech constraints: need version pinning (must pin to a deterministic model for compliance), fallback to quantized smaller model when latency spikes, seamless routing across regions, support for incremental indexing (avoid full reindex nightly), and batch tuning recommendations.
- Observations from POC run: sustained 500k embeddings/hr using a 4-GPU Dedicated pool (initial tuning). Batch size tuned to 512 embeddings/mini-batch. Prefix/KV cache produced 65% hit rate on common completions which reduced per-token cost ~28%. Streaming test: tail latency occasionally hit 220ms under cold-starts — AE/SE recommending warm prefetch and sticky routing.
- Quote: CTO (L. Moretti) — "We can't accept >200ms median lag for inline engine; determinism for audits is non-negotiable."
- Security: requires SSO/SAML + enterprise KMS integration and audit logs exported to Splunk. Also needs regional data residency for EU customers (some codebases remain in EU cloud).
- Cost sensitivity: total cost target for production infra ~<$18k/mo for a 50-seat team (highly sensitive to embedding refresh cost). Looking to Optimize to recommend batching/quantization that preserves completion quality.
- Stakeholders: CTO, Head of Platform, Infra lead, Security officer. SE and AE demos have primary traction; legal procurement kick off after security clarifications.
- Next actions (short): finalize dedicated sizing (capacity + burst), legal to confirm DPA/KMS wording, run 72-hr soak with production traces, produce quantization recommendation report from Redwood Optimize.
- Notes style: shorthand, action items, and call refs stored in drive + jira.
